transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Small villa property in the rice fields near Ubud town

activities.name: Central Bali in a vintage Volkswagen
activities.match: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Tirta Empul
activities.description: An open top vintage Volkswagen for the day through the rice fields, with the jungle swing, Tegenungan waterfall and the holy spring temple at Tirta Empul.

activities.name: Bedugul lakes and Tanah Lot sunset
activities.description: The Handara gate, the lake temple of Ulun Danu Beratan in the cool highlands, then Tanah Lot on the rocks as the sun goes down.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Three nights inland with a vintage Volkswagen day through central Bali and a highland day up to the Bedugul lake temples.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Uluwatu and Nusa Penida
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Garden hotel with a pool, a short walk from Seminyak beach

activities.name: Melasti beach, water sports and Uluwatu
activities.description: The white sand of Melasti beach, parasailing and a jet ski at Tanjung Benoa, then Uluwatu at sunset with the Kecak fire dance.

activities.name: Nusa Penida west with Paluang cliff
activities.description: Speedboat across for the Paluang cliff viewpoint, Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong and Broken Bay with your own guide.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Two nights on the coast with a south Bali day that ends at Uluwatu, and a full island day on Nusa Penida.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to Ubud
Check in at your villa in the rice fields
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: the Ubud market lanes or the Monkey Forest
2: Breakfast, then an open top vintage Volkswagen for the day
A turn on the jungle swing above the valley
Tegenungan waterfall and the rice terraces
Tirta Empul, the holy spring temple, before the drive back
3: Breakfast, then north into the highlands
Ulun Danu Beratan, the temple standing on the lake
Sunset at Tanah Lot on the way back
4: Breakfast and check out, then south to Melasti beach
Parasailing and a jet ski at Tanjung Benoa
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs at sunset
Kecak fire dance, then check in near Seminyak
5: Early breakfast, then private transfer to Sanur harbour
The Paluang cliff viewpoint and Kelingking beach
Angel's Billabong and Broken Bay before the boat back
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: The vintage Volkswagen day is the one couples put on the wall when they get home. Open top, rice fields, no hurry.
expert.tip: Keep the Nusa Penida day for the end so a rough sea morning can be swapped with the Uluwatu day. Both work either way around.

summary: Six days for two with three nights in the Ubud rice fields for a vintage Volkswagen day and the Bedugul lake temples, then two nights near Seminyak with Melasti beach, water sports, Uluwatu at sunset and a full day on Nusa Penida.
included: Included: 5 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; central Bali tour in a vintage Volkswagen with Tirta Empul; full day Bedugul tour with Tanah Lot sunset; Melasti beach with water sports, Uluwatu and the Kecak dance; Nusa Penida west coast tour with the Paluang cliff.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
